A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Bayesian semantic-entropy estimator. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–D are readable and support reliable matching across additions and relocations.

before.justification: v1 reports original hallucination-detection AUROC experiments using three LLMs, fixed and adaptive sampling budgets, and an appendix hyperparameter-sensitivity analysis.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds fixed-budget and adaptive-budget evaluations of Llama-3.3-70B on TriviaQA.

M1.justification: The Dirichlet estimator, sequence-probability constraints, unknown-support mixture, numerical integration, and adaptive stopping rule are unchanged. Algorithm 1 adds an explanatory reference to the existing truncated-Dirichlet definition, without changing the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate hallucination detection on TriviaQA, SQuAD, SVAMP, and NQ. The added Llama-3.3-70B experiment retains the existing TriviaQA task and data coverage.

E2.justification: The evaluated comparators remain sequence log likelihood, P(True), histogram semantic entropy, and rescaled semantic entropy with and without length normalization. The new 70B experiment uses this same comparator set.

E3.justification: Section 6.1 adds a larger model configuration, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, evaluated on TriviaQA with 8-bit quantization. Existing sampling budgets, temperatures, AUROC metric, and 200/800 training/test split are retained.

E4.justification: Appendix D retains the same Llama-2/TriviaQA sensitivity analysis for alpha values 0.1, 0.5, and 1.0, including unchanged plots. No additional ablation, robustness test, or error analysis is reported.

E5.justification: Both versions generate uncertainty estimates through resampling with replacement and report 1.96 times the standard error, using the same overlapping-confidence-bar bolding rule. No run-count, seed, or statistical-testing information is added.

E6.justification: Table 1, Figure 1, and Appendix C add Llama-3.3-70B/TriviaQA results; at N=2, SE-Bayes achieves 0.775 ± 0.003 AUROC versus SE-Histogram's 0.653 ± 0.006. All 120 retained appendix result rows and original plots are unchanged. Reported average sample savings change from 41% to 47%.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, estimator equations, Lemmas A.1–A.4, and Appendix A derivations retain their substance. The new Bayesian-benefits and consistency discussions provide explanations without adding a formal result or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract strengthens the quantitative efficiency claim from requiring 59% to 53% of baseline samples; the contribution statement correspondingly changes savings from 41% to 47%. The central claims about Bayesian estimation, adaptive allocation, and usefulness with one sample remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 3.4 adds a rationale involving learned priors, evidence combination, and variance-based allocation. Section 6.2 explains the lack of convergence within the tested budgets, and Section 7 newly acknowledges limited prior expressivity and suggests richer hierarchical priors.

D1.justification: Appendix B newly specifies 8-bit precision for Llama-3.3-70B, 16-bit for Mistral, and 32-bit for Llama-2 and Llama-3.2, and describes a Jupyter notebook that regenerates the tables and figures. Precision settings for retained models are newly disclosed, without evidence of changed settings. Code and data release remain promised upon acceptance.

R1.justification: v2 adds Nemenman et al. (2001) when discussing richer entropy priors and explicitly identifies sequence-probability conditioning as novel in Section 3.2. The existing related-work discussion and other cited works are retained.

P1.justification: v2 adds localized explanations, reorganizes Appendix B around inference and entropy-estimation stages, expands the conclusion into limitations and perspectives, and corrects several wording errors. The overall section sequence and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds the 70B adaptive-budget plot and corresponding table rows, clarifies Table 1's AUROC caption, and introduces publication headers. Existing plots are relocated or resized, and Appendix D's plots move onto the page containing its explanation; their content is retained.

improvement.justification: v2 adds useful validation at 70B parameters, improves implementation disclosure in Appendix B, and explains the estimator's rationale and prior limitations more clearly. These strengthen empirical support and interpretability. The gain is limited: the new model is tested only on TriviaQA, while the method, proofs, and original results remain unchanged.
